mapper.select: SELECT book_id, book_name, book_code, book_type, currency, org_id, org_name, status, description, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM finance_book WHERE book_id = #{bookId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO finance_book ( book_id, book_name, book_code, book_type, currency, org_id, org_name, status, description, create_by, create_time ) VALUES ( #{book.bookId}, #{book.bookName}, #{book.bookCode}, #{book.bookType}, #{book.currency}, #{book.orgId}, #{book.orgName}, #{book.status}, #{book.description}, #{book.createBy}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE finance_book SET book_name = #{book.bookName}, book_code = #{book.bookCode}, book_type = #{book.bookType}, currency = #{book.currency}, org_id = #{book.orgId}, org_name = #{book.orgName}, status = #{book.status}, description = #{book.description}, update_by = #{book.updateBy}, update_time = SYSDATE WHERE book_id = #{book.bookId}
mapper.select: SELECT book_type, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as active_count FROM finance_book GROUP BY book_type
